The voluntary plans of all domestic manufacturers, except for AMC, were indicated to the agency in the manufacturers' response to the agency's request for the plans.
Although the AFES applies to all manufacturers of NPA's, the development of the AFES concentrated on domestic NPA's since their fuel economy is considerably below that of imported NPA's (15.9 mpg for all domestics compared to 22.1 for all imports in MY 1976). The baseline fuel economy from which fuel savings were determined included vehicles imported and marketed by Ford and GM (captive imports). AMC and Chrysler do not have captive imports. The AFES for MY 1979 also includes the effect of captive imports on average fuel economy levels. However, all fuel savings and other environmental impacts result from actions by domestic manufacturers on domestically manufactured vehicles.
